fields.description: Issue includes coverage of an alleged beating involving Detective Lt. C. O. Huttoe and Chief of Detectives James Barker; editorials criticizing the Dade County Crime Commission and discussing law enforcement practices and civil rights; reporting on a child-molestation allegation and related court proceedings before Justice of the Peace Edwin Lee Mason; discussion of bookmaking and racetrack gambling and their economic impact on Dade County; local event planning for a Coconut Harvest Festival and Luau at Crandon Park/Key Biscayne; notes on a Collier County oil well near Sunniland/Immokalee; and additional local commentary including a divorce scandal item and a report on employment of minors at a Miami restaurant/bar.
